crossRefs.note: for her house leads down to death, her paths to the departed spirits.
None who go to her return again, neither do they attain to the paths of life.
Her house is the way to Sheol, going down to the rooms of death.

translations.web: Her feet go down to death. Her steps lead straight to Sheol.
translations.bsb: Her feet go down to death; her steps lead straight to Sheol.
translations.kjv: Her feet go down to death; her steps take hold on hell.
